# Compare Hub Template V1 — Copy Ready

> Copy this file when drafting a multi-company comparison article. Replace bracketed placeholders, then move the finished article into `src/data/articles/`.

```md
---
title: "[Theme] [N]사 비교｜[Company A]·[Company B]·[Company C]"
description: "[Theme] 대표 기업을 밸류체인·수요 가시성·생산능력·마진·경쟁우위·밸류에이션 기준으로 비교합니다."
category: "투자·경제"
tags:
  - [theme]
  - [company A]
  - [company B]
  - [company C]
  - 비교
publishedAt: YYYY-MM-DD
updatedAt: YYYY-MM-DD
author: "JoyLab"
featured: false
draft: true
seoTitle: "[Theme] [N]사 비교｜[2–3 decision variables]"
series: "[series name]"
readingTime: "약 12분"
---

[Theme]에서 [Company A], [Company B], [Company C]를 비교할 때 중요한 질문은 **누가 더 좋은 회사인가가 아니라, 현재 사이클에서 중요한 변수에 누가 가장 직접적으로 노출돼 있는가**입니다.

이 글은 [[Pillar/Guide]](/[guide-path])와 개별 Company Research V1을 같은 기준으로 정렬합니다.
```

## Pre-PR Checklist

- [ ] Compare Hub Template V1 sequence followed
- [ ] same lens applied symmetrically to every company
- [ ] Company Research V1 links added where available
- [ ] comparable periods and definitions used
- [ ] sector-normalized demand visibility lens selected
- [ ] one common valuation reference date stated
- [ ] consolidated vs segment metrics normalized
- [ ] scorecard judgments have evidence and avoid false precision
- [ ] Bull / Base / Bear includes relative company sensitivity
- [ ] Fact / Interpretation / Scenario / Action completed
- [ ] relevant Pillar/Guide internal link added
- [ ] V2 Design System Gold Gate checked
- [ ] desktop sticky TOC works
- [ ] table/long-name wrapping checked at 390px
- [ ] no horizontal page overflow
- [ ] no literal Markdown emphasis markers visible in built HTML
- [ ] URL/canonical/sitemap/RSS behavior preserved
- [ ] Astro build / dependency audit pass
- [ ] production smoke test pass after merge
